name: cortex
description: Cortex daily memory for Claude Code. Hands each lifecycle event to the installed cortex-hook binary, which starts the local Cortex runtime on demand and returns saved memory context, and adds the daily Cortex MCP tools. Requires the Cortex binaries (cortex-hook, cortex-mcp-server, cortex-api, cortex-adapter-claude) installed with `cortex-ops install-binaries` and a user configuration written by `cortex-ops setup`. No telemetry; nothing leaves this machine.

bin_dir.title: Cortex binary directory
bin_dir.description: Absolute path of the directory holding cortex-hook, only needed when it is neither on PATH nor in ~/.cortex/bin. A relative path is ignored.

api_url.title: Cortex API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the local Cortex API. Leave empty to use dashboard.api_url from ~/.cortex/config.toml (http://127.0.0.1:17000 by default).
